    Calculate conditional ETAs (ETA prim)

    calcEtas.Rd

    Collects the ETAs (parameter and covariate) from a FREM model and computes the ETA_prims.

    Usage

    calcEtas(
  runno = NULL,
  numNonFREMThetas,
  modName = NULL,
  numSkipOm = 0,
  idvar = "ID",
  modDevDir = NULL,
  FFEMData = NULL,
  covmodel = "linear",
  dataFile = NULL,
  parNames = NULL,
  quiet = TRUE,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    runno

    The run number. Must be provided if modName is NULL. Will be used to create NONMEM model and results file names with the structure run#.mod and run#. NONMEM ext, phi and cov files will be assumed to be named run# followed by the appropriate suffix (where # is runno).

    numNonFREMThetas

    Number of thetas in the FREM model that are not FREM covariates. These need to come before the FREM covariate thetas in the FREM model file.

    modName

    The model name. Will be used together with modExt, lstExt, ext, phi and cov to form the NONMEM file names, for example modName.mod for the model file.

    numSkipOm

    Number of diagonal omegas that should not be part of the FREM calculations. Such omegas has to come before the large FREM omega block in the FREM model file.

    idvar

    The name of the ID column,

    modDevDir

    The directory where the files reside. Default is the current directory, i.e. ".".

    FFEMData

    An FFEMData object as obtained with the function createFFEMdata. If NULL, the object will be created internally, requiring dataFile, parNames, and other arguments for createFFEMdata to be provided.

    covmodel

    A character string indicating if the covariate models were implemented linearly (additatively) in the frem model or not. Default is "linear".

    dataFile

    The name of the data file used in the base model, i.e. the original data file, or a data.frame with the same data.

    parNames

    Names of the parameters. Only used in the STDOUT when quiet =FALSE or in eqFile if it is non-blank. Defaults to Par folowed by a number.

    quiet

    If FALSE, will print the FFEM model + associated $OMEGA BLOCK to STDOUT.

    ...

    Additional arguments passed on to createFFEMdata when FFEMData is NULL.

    Value

    A data.frame with one row per subject, containing the individual parameter estimates. The data frame includes the following columns:

    • ID: The subject identifier.

    • ETA_PRIM*: One column for each parameter's conditional ETA (ETA_prim). This is the random effect adjusted for the individual's specific covariate effects.

    • ETA*: One column for each parameter's raw ETA as reported in the FREM model output.

    • Covariate Columns: Columns for each covariate, containing the individual covariate estimates. If covmodel = "linear", these values are on the original covariate scale; otherwise, they are on the ETA scale.

    Details

    The function collects the ETAs from the output of a FREM model, both for the parameters as well as the covariates. The corresponding ETA_prims for the parameter ETAs are computed by extracting the corresponding individual covariate coefficient provided in the FFEMData object.

    See also

    createFFEMdata() for information about creating the FFEMData object

    Other Diagnostics & Plotting: fremParameterTable(), getExplainedVar(), getForestDFFREM(), plotExplainedVar(), traceplot()

    Examples

    
# 1. Define the path to the model files included with the package
model_dir <- system.file("extdata/SimNeb/", package = "PMXFrem")

# 2. Load and prepare the dataset also included with the package
data_path <- system.file("extdata/SimNeb/DAT-2-MI-PMX-2-onlyTYPE2-new.csv",
                         package = "PMXFrem")

my_data <- read.csv(data_path)

# In this example dataset, BLQ=1 rows are excluded
my_data <- my_data[my_data$BLQ != 1, ]

# 3. Call calcEtas, providing the data directly
# The function will create the FFEMData object internally.
individual_etas <- calcEtas(
  modName          = "run31",
  modDevDir        = model_dir,
  numNonFREMThetas = 7,
  numSkipOm        = 2,
  dataFile         = my_data,
  parNames         = c("CL", "V", "MAT")
)
#> `FFEMData` object not provided. Creating it internally...

# 4. Display the first few rows of the resulting data frame
# The output contains subject IDs, ETAs, ETA_PRIMs, and covariate values.
head(individual_etas)
